# Anderson Mautone

> Senior Software Architect | AI & GenAI Engineer | Senior Full Stack Developer
> São Paulo, Brasil — contato@mautone.com.br — https://mautone.com.br

Anderson Mautone is a software architect and generative AI engineer with 28 years of experience in corporate systems, SaaS, ERP/CRM, APIs, cloud and Full Stack development. International education at Université de Liège (Belgium).

## Expertise

- Generative AI / GenAI, LLMs, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
- Hybrid Search, Semantic Search, Vector Search, embeddings
- AI Agents, tool calling, function calling, n8n automations
- Integration of AI with corporate APIs and systems
- Go / Golang microservices, Python / FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js
- MongoDB, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Supabase, SQL, Oracle
- Software Architecture, Solution Architecture, Cloud-Native, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP

## Notable projects

- CADBRASIL: advanced Hybrid Search with RAG and n8n automations over corporate document knowledge bases.
- Corporate RAG platform: document pipeline, chunking, embeddings, PostgreSQL/pgvector, semantic search and LLM integration.
- Grupo Sorrisos: ERP/CRM architecture and development for dental operations.
- Products: GooDesk, UniStays, WeJob, Selfmart, Desenvolve Bem, Investin.
